details.question: Who took the most wickets in the 2019 season?
details.sql: SELECT bowler, SUM(wickets) AS wickets, SUM(legal_balls) AS legal_balls FROM marts.mart_bowling_phase WHERE season_year = 2019 GROUP BY bowler ORDER BY wickets DESC LIMIT 5

details.question: How many matches were played in the 2020 season?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches FROM marts.fct_matches WHERE season_year = 2020 LIMIT 200

details.question: Who won the IPL final in 2009?
details.sql: SELECT team FROM marts.mart_team_season WHERE season_year = 2009 AND is_champion LIMIT 200

details.question: Who has hit the most sixes in IPL history?
details.sql: SELECT batter, SUM(sixes) AS career_sixes FROM marts.mart_batting_season GROUP BY batter ORDER BY career_sixes DESC LIMIT 5

details.question: How many IPL hundreds has Virat Kohli scored?
details.sql: SELECT batter, SUM(hundreds) AS hundreds FROM marts.mart_batting_season WHERE batter = 'V Kohli' GROUP BY batter LIMIT 200

details.question: Which bowler has the most career IPL wickets?
details.sql: SELECT bowler, SUM(wickets) AS career_wickets FROM marts.mart_bowling_phase GROUP BY bowler ORDER BY career_wickets DESC LIMIT 5

details.question: Which batter has the best career batting average with at least 2000 runs?
details.sql: SELECT batter, SUM(runs) AS career_runs, SUM(dismissals) AS dismissals, ROUND(SUM(runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(dismissals), 0), 2) AS batting_average FROM marts.mart_batting_season GROUP BY batter HAVING SUM(runs) >= 2000 ORDER BY batting_average DESC LIMIT 10

details.question: Which bowler has the best career economy rate, minimum 1000 legal balls?
details.sql: SELECT bowler, SUM(legal_balls) AS legal_balls, SUM(runs_conceded) AS runs_conceded, ROUND(SUM(runs_conceded) * 6.0 / SUM(legal_balls), 2) AS economy FROM marts.mart_bowling_phase GROUP BY bowler HAVING SUM(legal_balls) >= 1000 ORDER BY SUM(runs_conceded) * 6.0 / SUM(legal_balls) LIMIT 5

details.question: Who has taken the most death-over wickets in IPL history?
details.sql: SELECT bowler, SUM(wickets) AS death_wickets, SUM(legal_balls) AS legal_balls FROM marts.mart_bowling_phase WHERE phase = 'death' GROUP BY bowler ORDER BY death_wickets DESC LIMIT 10

details.question: What was the overall powerplay run rate in the 2025 season?
details.sql: SELECT SUM(runs_total) AS powerplay_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN is_legal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls, ROUND(SUM(runs_total) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN is_legal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS powerplay_run_rate FROM marts.fct_deliveries WHERE season_year = 2025 AND phase = 'powerplay' AND NOT is_super_over LIMIT 200

details.question: How many times have Kolkata Knight Riders beaten Royal Challengers Bengaluru?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS kkr_wins FROM marts.fct_matches WHERE winner = 'Kolkata Knight Riders' AND loser = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru' LIMIT 200

details.question: How many times has Rashid Khan dismissed MS Dhoni?
details.sql: SELECT batter, bowler, SUM(CASE WHEN is_ball_faced THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls, SUM(runs_batter) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN is_bowler_wicket AND player_out = batter THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals FROM marts.fct_deliveries WHERE batter = 'MS Dhoni' AND bowler = 'Rashid Khan' AND NOT is_super_over GROUP BY batter, bowler LIMIT 200

details.question: Which venue has hosted the most IPL matches?
details.sql: SELECT venue, city, matches FROM marts.dim_venues ORDER BY matches DESC LIMIT 5

details.question: How many IPL matches were played in South Africa?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches FROM marts.fct_matches WHERE country = 'South Africa' LIMIT 200

details.question: How many IPL matches have been decided by a super over?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS super_over_matches FROM marts.fct_matches WHERE decided_by_super_over LIMIT 200

details.question: Which team has won the most super overs?
details.sql: SELECT team, SUM(super_over_wins) AS super_over_wins, SUM(super_over_losses) AS super_over_losses FROM marts.mart_team_season GROUP BY team ORDER BY super_over_wins DESC LIMIT 10

details.question: What is the highest team total in an IPL innings?
details.sql: SELECT team, runs, opposition, match_date, venue FROM (SELECT first_innings_team AS team, first_innings_runs AS runs, second_innings_team AS opposition, match_date, venue FROM marts.fct_matches UNION ALL SELECT second_innings_team, second_innings_runs, first_innings_team, match_date, venue FROM marts.fct_matches) AS t WHERE runs IS NOT NULL ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 5

details.question: What is the lowest completed first-innings total in the IPL (all out or 20 overs, no rain)?
details.sql: SELECT match_date, first_innings_team, second_innings_team AS opponent, first_innings_runs, first_innings_wickets, first_innings_balls, venue, season_year FROM marts.fct_matches WHERE NOT is_dl_result AND result_type <> 'no result' AND (first_innings_wickets = 10 OR first_innings_balls >= 120) AND first_innings_runs IS NOT NULL ORDER BY first_innings_runs ASC LIMIT 5

details.question: Who has the most fifties (50 to 99) in IPL history?
details.sql: SELECT batter, SUM(fifties) AS career_fifties FROM marts.mart_batting_season GROUP BY batter ORDER BY career_fifties DESC LIMIT 5

details.question: How many ducks has Rohit Sharma made in the IPL?
details.sql: SELECT batter, SUM(ducks) AS career_ducks FROM marts.mart_batting_season WHERE batter = 'RG Sharma' GROUP BY batter LIMIT 200

details.question: Which team had the best win percentage in the 2008 season?
details.sql: SELECT team, matches, wins, losses, win_pct FROM marts.mart_team_season WHERE season_year = 2008 ORDER BY win_pct DESC LIMIT 5

details.question: How many finals have Chennai Super Kings played?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS finals_played, STRING_AGG(CAST(season_year AS TEXT), ', ' ORDER BY season_year) AS seasons, SUM(CASE WHEN is_champion THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS titles_won FROM marts.mart_team_season WHERE team = 'Chennai Super Kings' AND reached_final LIMIT 200

details.question: In how many matches did the toss winner choose to field first?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches_toss_winner_chose_field FROM marts.fct_matches WHERE toss_decision = 'field' LIMIT 200

details.question: How many matches were affected by rain and decided by Duckworth-Lewis?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS dl_matches FROM marts.fct_matches WHERE is_dl_result LIMIT 200

details.question: What is the biggest winning margin by runs in IPL history, and who won?
details.sql: SELECT match_date, season_year, winner, loser, win_by_runs, venue FROM marts.fct_matches WHERE win_by_runs IS NOT NULL ORDER BY win_by_runs DESC LIMIT 5

details.question: How many run outs have there been in IPL history, super overs excluded?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS run_outs FROM marts.fct_deliveries WHERE wicket_kind = 'run out' AND NOT is_super_over LIMIT 200

details.question: Which team bowled the most wides in the 2022 season?
details.sql: SELECT team, SUM(wide_balls) AS wides_bowled FROM marts.mart_bowling_phase WHERE season_year = 2022 GROUP BY team ORDER BY wides_bowled DESC LIMIT 1

details.question: Which player has played in the most IPL seasons?
details.sql: SELECT player, seasons_played, first_season, last_season FROM marts.dim_players WHERE seasons_played = (SELECT MAX(seasons_played) FROM marts.dim_players) ORDER BY player LIMIT 200

details.question: Who has scored the most runs in IPL playoff matches?
details.sql: SELECT batter, SUM(runs) AS playoff_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(balls_faced) AS balls_faced FROM marts.fct_batting_innings WHERE is_playoff GROUP BY batter ORDER BY playoff_runs DESC LIMIT 10

details.question: Who won the orange cap (most runs) in each season from 2020 to 2024?
details.sql: SELECT season_year, batter, team, runs FROM (SELECT season_year, batter, team, runs, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season_year ORDER BY runs DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT season_year, batter, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT team, ', ') AS team, SUM(runs) AS runs FROM marts.mart_batting_season WHERE season_year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2024 GROUP BY season_year, batter) AS t) AS r WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY season_year LIMIT 200
